title: HookKit ABI Baseline
description: One ABI snapshot. Tools/abi/extract_abi.py produces snapshots from a built framework and Tools/abi/compare_abi.py compares two snapshots. Fields the extractor could not populate are omitted, not fabricated as empty/null -- see each field's description for what "absent" means.

tag.description: Git tag or commit this baseline was extracted from, e.g. "v2.5.0".

exported_symbols.description: Exported symbol names, per architecture -- two builds can differ per-slice (e.g. an old-ABI arm64e lane exporting a narrower set), so this is never flattened into one arch-agnostic list.

objc.description: Classes, methods, properties, and type encodings. Omitted entirely (not an empty object) when the selected Mach-O toolchain cannot provide ObjC metadata -- check extractor_version / the ledger before treating an absent objc field as "this release has no ObjC classes".

enum_values.description: Optional enum name -> numeric value snapshot. Sourced from header parsing, not the binary -- omitted (not {}) when no enum header was supplied.

additionalProperties.description: SHA-256 of the header file at this path, relative to the repo root.

type_encoding.description: Per-architecture type encoding, since encodings can differ by arch (e.g. NSInteger width).
